premises: Annealing at 550 °C for 2 h refines the AlCoCrFeNi HEA coating microstructure to ~15 µm grain size with low-angle boundaries and a major BCC phase
The refined microstructure rapidly forms stable, passive Al- and Cr-rich oxide/hydroxide layers (e.g., Cr2O3, Fe(OH)3, Cr(OH)3, Co(OH)2)
The passive layers impede pit initiation and corrosive ion ingress in 3.5 wt% H2SO4 and 900 °C salt mixtures
Deviations from 550 °C annealing cause grain growth and unfavorable phase transitions that reduce corrosion suppression
The coating and annealing strategy is effective on analogous SS316L systems
